item.description:

item.title: [6.8] DyPES-VLA: Learning Shared Dynamics Priors and Embodiment-Specific Control for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robot manipulation, but training a single generalist policy for heterogeneous robot embodiments remains an open problem. Existing methods have two main limitations. First, they underuse dynamics priors shared across diverse visual and interaction data, limiting cross-embodiment transfer.

WHY IT MATTERS

DyPES-VLA introduces a compelling architecture for cross-embodiment robot manipulation by combining shared dynamics priors with a mixture-of-experts action head, addressing a key scalability bottleneck in robotics.

item.title: [6.7] Is 'Trumpflation' real? Why Wall Street fears this could be a reason for stock market crash
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Wall Street's record rally faces a new test as 'Trumpflation' concerns grow alongside AI-driven pricing pressures. Sticky core PCE inflation at 3.3% and rising Treasury yields raise fears that the Federal Reserve could hold interest rates higher for longer or hike rates, threatening high equity valuations.
